notes.title: Massive Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!  This is Raffaele, the creator of Champions of Odin.  I am
extremely excited to release a massive update for the game!
The game is completely different than how it was when it was released in 2017, 
so I made a list of updates below.  I felt like I released the game way too early back in 2017, even for Early Access.  It was basically a prototype at that point.  I have been working on the game constantly ever since, but wanted to wait to release updates until the game was close to the vision I had for it's potential.  That update is here! Enjoy.

-Story Mode
There is a new story mode!  The story has been re-written, you are now playing as mighty Odin, god of the nine worlds.

-New nordic fjord environment with a lindwyrm theme!  There are now two environments,
with about 1.5 -3 hours of gameplay depending on skill.

-All new enemies, with improved AI and special effects!

-All new player mechanics!

Disclaimer : The game has bugs.  The current gameplay mechanics will be tweaked and adjusted in the future and the difficulty might be adjusted.  I don't have a QA team, so if you find a bug, please e-mail me at support@championsofodin.com and I will fix it.

I hope you enjoy the game and thank you for playing!

-Raffaele

notes.title: Major Update coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!  This is Raffaele, the creator of Champions of Odin.  I wanted to let you all know what I am working on for the next major release :)  The first major part of the storyline is being developed and incorporated into the game as we speak!  The goal for the next build will be to include:

1. Storyline Scene! 

2.  New second environment full of Lindwyrm dragon madness :)

3.  The current level included in Champions of Odin is being reworked.  There will be really cool new creatures and a slightly different layout with greatly improved performance.  (The new layout happened because I was trying to get the game running on Xbox smooth as butta, and ended up liking the new layout better lol) Also, I am fixing all of the bugs!

I am working as hard and fast as I can (giggity) and I will really try to not let these features take forever.  I will update you guys as each feature is completed, e-mail me if you have any questions :)

-Raffaele
